orderDevices.help: Allocate devices, create fulfillments and ship from this order. Unshipped devices can be released and reallocated.
orderDevices.splitHelp: Select devices from one warehouse or supplier. Create separate fulfillments for different sources.

deviceScan.deleteIntakeConfirm: Delete the newly received device {{serial}}? Its device record and audit history will be retained.

deviceScan.title: Device intake & dispatch
deviceScan.subtitle: One record per device · Warehouse and supplier shipping · Intake, allocation, shipping, after-sales and resale

deviceScan.sourceCreated: Supply source created and linked to the default sales channel.
deviceScan.inventoryEnabled: Device management is enabled for this SKU.

deviceScan.takeoverConfirm: I understand device tracking is independent of quantity stock.
deviceScan.takeoverSuccess: SKU device tracking enabled. Stock is unchanged.
deviceScan.supplierHelp: Supplier availability is recorded for reference only. It does not change SKU stock.
deviceScan.supplierUpdated: Supplier availability updated. Stock is unchanged.
deviceScan.intakeHelp: Standard devices become available immediately after intake. Register them ahead of allocation without changing stock.
deviceScan.intakeSuccess: Intake complete. Standard devices are available; stock is unchanged.
deviceScan.csvHelp: In the XLSX template, search and select a complete specification in SKU Parameters. SKU fills automatically and is locked. Type model, storage, color, grade or battery keywords, press Enter, then reopen the parameter dropdown to choose a match. Search terms alone cannot be imported. Leave parameters blank to use the SKU selected above. Grade and battery default to the SKU configuration. Identifiers are formatted as text. Chinese, English and legacy column names are supported. Download a new template after SKU changes.
deviceScan.csvTemplate: Download XLSX template with SKU dropdown
deviceScan.batchSuccess: Batch received. Standard devices are available; returned and recycled devices await inspection. Stock is unchanged.

deviceScan.supplierAllocated: Supplier device registered and allocated to the order.
deviceScan.allocateHelp: Scan or select an available device below, then allocate it. Devices from different sources can be shipped in separate batches.
deviceScan.released: Allocation released. Choose another device. Any existing fulfillment was canceled; its other devices remain allocated and need a new fulfillment.

deviceScan.fulfillmentCreated: Order fulfillment created and stock deducted. Enter tracking details to ship.
deviceScan.shipSuccess: Devices and order fulfillment marked as shipped.

returnTransfer.title: Move to returned devices
returnTransfer.help: Move this device from the sale devices list into returned devices awaiting inspection. The transfer reason and operator will be recorded in the processing log.
returnTransfer.saved: Device moved to returned devices awaiting inspection.

returnProcessing.title: Set processing status
returnProcessing.help: Returned devices start awaiting inspection. Passing inspection moves the device to the sale devices list as available. Devices under an active original-device repair request become ready to return to the customer instead. Supplier returns require an original supplier source.
returnProcessing.required: Select a SKU and grade, enter a whole battery percentage from 0 to 100, and add processing notes.

deviceScan.photosHelp: Optional, up to 8 JPG, PNG or WebP photos. Photos are compressed automatically.
deviceScan.saleIntakeHelp: Standard devices become available immediately after intake. Register them ahead of allocation without changing stock.
deviceScan.reviewIntakeHelp: Returned and recycled devices await inspection, then become available after passing. Device operations do not change stock.
deviceScan.saleIntakeSuccess: Intake complete. Device is available; stock is unchanged.
deviceScan.deleteConfirm: Soft delete device {{serial}}? Audit history is retained and stock is unchanged.

buyback.unavailable: No storage options are configured for this model.
buyback.unsureHelp: Battery capacity needs to be confirmed during inspection.
buyback.batteryError: Enter a whole number from 1 to 100, or choose Unable to check.
buyback.none: No cracks, chips or heavy scratches
buyback.cannotBuyHelp: Devices that cannot stay powered on or connect to a mobile network cannot continue through this buyback flow. You can edit your answers or start over.
subtitles: Check the functionality of your device
Inspect for bright spots, dead pixels or lines/burn-in
Inspect screen for cracks, chips and heavy scratches
Inspect screen for scratches and wear
Inspect sides for scratches and wear
Inspect back for scratches and wear
help: Find in Settings → General → About → Model Name
Find in Settings → Battery → Battery Health & Charging
checks: Does your device power on and stay on without restarting?
Hold the side button. Charge the phone if needed, then check whether it stays on without restarting.
Can your device connect to a network?
Dial *#06# and check that the IMEI appears. If it does not, choose No.
Lock your phone and try unlocking it with Face ID. You can check setup in Settings → Face ID & Passcode.
Open the camera in selfie mode and check that the picture is clear.
Does the speaker at the top of your device work?
Play a ringtone in Settings → Sounds & Haptics. Cover the bottom speaker and listen to the top speaker.
touchId: Lock your phone and try unlocking it with your fingerprint.
glass: There are visible cracks that you can feel with a fingertip.
There are chips, including around the edges of the screen.
Many scratches are visible without shining a light on the screen.
screenHelp: Noticeable scratches are visible without a light and can be felt.
Light scratches or marks, often near the corners.
Micro scratches that become visible under a light.
No visible scratches, including under a light.
frameHelp: Bent, cracked or severely dented sides; damage can be felt with a fingernail.
Clear scratches, dents or discolouration that can be felt.
Scratches, marks or a small dent, often around the charging port.
Minor scratches visible under a light.
The sides look new, with no visible scratches under a light.
backHelp: Cracked back glass or dented metal; damage can be felt with a fingernail.
Clear scratches, dents or colour marks that can be felt.
Visible scratches or wear marks, often around the camera.
Minor scratches visible under a light.
The back looks new, with no visible scratches under a light.
buyback.title: Register recycled phone
buyback.description: Record the customer's phone manually, following the storefront buyback questionnaire. No barcode is needed.
buyback.configurationHelp: Select the matching colour and catalogue configuration. The detailed condition below is recorded separately; registration does not make the phone available for sale.
buyback.identityHelp: Read the serial number and IMEI from Settings → General → About. Enter them manually; a packaging barcode is not needed.
buyback.required: Complete the required fields before continuing.
buyback.costHelp: Leave blank if the buyback price has not been agreed. No online estimate is calculated.
buyback.success: Recycled phone registered and awaiting inspection. Stock is unchanged.
buyback.leaveHelp: The information entered has not been saved.
buyback.batteryTier: The battery health is below this catalogue configuration's minimum. Choose a suitable configuration.
buyback.unknownBattery: Battery health is unconfirmed. Any catalogue battery tier is a reference only; confirm the actual health during inspection.
